thread:
maria: kicking off staggered rollout for runtime v2.4.0 in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. plan: wave1=2% (api+runtime+console pinned), wave2=10% after 30m if stable. router remains on stable with header-compat mode enabled. please watch schema mismatch errors.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan submitted. runtime v2.4.0 -> wave1 2% at +2m. Pins: console=1.5.0, api=2.0.1-compat. Header-compat enabled on router. Track: /deploy/logs/6265432100

jon: quick note: staging run showed 'X-User-Flags' header renamed in runtime -> causes 503s when router uses strict header validation. header-compat toggle should mitigate but we should still observe.

api-team: we shipped a compatibility shim (api=2.0.1-compat) to accept both header names. no schema migration required. :+1:

liz: infra-bot shows a small spike in 5xx in staging cluster during smoke with runtime v2.4.0. not critical but flagged. attaching logs.

infra-bot: [automated] smoke-tests: failures=4/500 (0.8%) in staging at 2026-03-23T01:10:12Z. See /ci/6265432000.

maria: ok i'm going to start wave1 but with a warmup and strict rollback gates. Warmup: 0.5% for 10m then bump to 2%. Rollback: abort if >0.4% 5xx or p95 increases by >200ms for 5m. Acks?

router-team: ack, enabling header-compat and adding router-side retry for backend-write timeouts for this rollout. We'll also limit new connections per node to avoid overload.

deploy-bot: Warmup job scheduled: warmup-6265432110 -> 0.5% for 10m. Canary will follow.

jon: posting warmup script (run from ops box):

```bash
for i in $(seq 1 50); do
  curl -s -H "X-User-Flags: test-$i" -H "Authorization: Bearer $WARMUP" https://api.internal/runtime/ping >/dev/null || echo "fail $i"
  sleep 0.5
done
```

maria: warmup started. monitoring dashboards: https://metrics.internal/redwood/dashboards/stagger-6265432100

liz: warmup looks fine but seeing intermittent 502s at router-edge-12. correlates with one node with high connection queue.

router-team: we can drain router-edge-12 and shift ~3% of its traffic to edge-9/11 temporarily. proposing traffic-slice update:

```yaml
traffic-edge-split:
  edge-9: 40
  edge-11: 40
  edge-12: 20  # draining down from 60
```

maria: implement drain. if errors persist after draining, we'll pause wave1 and apply a pin to runtime -> v2.3.x for the affected shards.

deploy-bot: traffic-slice updated as requested by maria. Edge-12 draining started.

infra-bot: Observability alert: backend-write-timeout rate increased to 0.45% on shard-12. Threshold for rollback is 0.4%.

api-team: those timeouts look like upstream schema validation rejects. even with header-compat some requests fail early. recommend pausing wave1 and reverting runtime on affected shard while we patch validation logic.

maria: pausing wave1 now. scaling runtime v2.4.0 -> 0% for affected shards and keeping pins on console/api. deploy-bot execute pause.

deploy-bot: Wave1 paused by maria. runtime v2.4.0 traffic -> 0% on shards [12,47]. Pins remain: console=1.5.0, api=2.0.1-compat.

liz: filing action item: patch runtime schema acceptance to accept legacy header casing and add a unit test. PR #501 created.

maria: good. let's keep router header-compat on until patch lands and tests pass. We'll re-run warmup + small smoke after PR merge, then re-evaluate for wave1 resume. Add rollback clause to release notes: 'If header-compat alerts or >0.4% 5xx, pause and pin router/runtime shards, escalate to oncall.'

jon: added release note line in PR #501 description.

deploy-bot: follow-up jobs scheduled: run-smoke-6265432200 after PR merge. Tickets updated: #INC-7920.

router-team: will keep drain on edge-12 until further notice.

maria: thanks all. keeping thread open for final rollforward decision. ping here once PR merges and smoke passes.

api-team: copying to #incidents as precaution.

liz: monitoring link: https://metrics.internal/redwood/dashboards/stagger-6265432100#shard=12

deploy-bot: thread note: paused, pins applied, PR #501 linked, incident #INC-7920 logged.
